name: The Hollow
source:
There exists the legend of a spirit that preys upon the dreams of those with guilt in their hearts. Can you survive a night with The Hollow?

The Hollow is a short visual novel inspired by So Sang the Hollow by Avatar.
The Hollow details one  individual's night with a spirit known as The Hollow, A spirit which supposedly preys upon those with guilt in their hearts, and uses their own guilt as a weapon against them, via memories, and impersonating people in the guily soul's life. Can you conquer your own guilt, and come out on the other end?
[From [url=https://melon-grab.itch.io/the-hollow]itch.io[/url]]
